description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Soft-top Hooks that mount to the tailgate/rear-gate of the Samurai.
These are SOLID BRASS!
Full Set of 4
Suzuki OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Brass Male Hooks w/Threaded Posts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
